decision_scope: Recommendation only; ranking balances evidence and cost, not predicted metric gains.

options.contract_amendment: Explicit new feature contract plus Stage16T compatibility amendment before any affected independent evaluation. Preserve v4.features.1 and Stage18.
options.expected_benefit: Address demonstrable S2/S4 historical/value/variation gaps before paying for another fit; keep A4 model comparison as a separate issue.
options.independent_evaluation: Original holdouts remain quarantined. Challenge feature/schema compatibility and freeze rules must be amended before generation/access, with independent custody intact.
options.justification: S2/S4 weak on Train and Validation; S4-only 0/12 in Validation; static irrecoverable components, not accuracy dissatisfaction alone.
options.new_dataset_required: No for design or future re-extraction of same immutable ledger; new feature/experiment version required.
options.option: Preserve XGBoost and complete a versioned feature-amendment design
options.refit_required: No now; yes to assess any future approved feature version.
options.required_data: Existing frozen design and authorized development diagnostics for design; later independent hand fixtures if implementation is authorized.
options.risks: Extra direct components can make synthetic rule learning easier without improving external validity; support remains sparse; hypothesis formed on reused Validation.

options.contract_amendment: No to retain; separate selection decision required to switch candidate.
options.expected_benefit: No further fit cost; honest binary development reference and preserved comparator.
options.independent_evaluation: Does not resolve custody/support requirements; no final model promotion.
options.justification: Original fixed selection rule remains valid; HGB rescues A4 errors but adds false positives and loses some network detections.
options.option: Retain current model with restricted claims and document HGB trade-off
options.risks: Known S2/S4 and exclusive-family failures remain; cannot meet full-family research objective.

options.contract_amendment: No if strictly diagnostic; any new model inputs require a versioned amendment.

options.independent_evaluation: No challenge/holdout access; later claims need untouched independent evidence.
options.justification: 187 Validation positives missed by both XGB/HGB; N3 summaries demonstrably lose some alternatives.
options.required_data: Existing development rows, prior observable histories, annotations and fixed predictions under a separate diagnostic authorization.
options.risks: Further Validation reuse; cannot quantify causal improvement from an inspection; do not search threshold grids.

options.contract_amendment: Existing Stage16T if current 40 fields retained; explicit compatibility amendment if future feature contract differs.

options.independent_evaluation: Cannot proceed locally under developer-controlled custody; no original seal repair or family-count leakage.
options.justification: Original holdout support policies failed; Stage16S/16T already require a separate estimand.

options.option: Provision custody and use the separately planned challenge evaluation

options.contract_amendment: New population/research protocol; frozen target remains unless separately justified and approved.

options.independent_evaluation: Independent future evaluation version compatible with amended population/feature task, no reuse of observed evaluation results.
options.justification: Train S2=112/S4=128 and nine objectives unmet; extra feature information alone cannot supply statistical support.

options.option: Versioned development population experiment only if needed
options.required_data: New prospective population specification, fixed opportunity law/seed policy and one retained draw, subject/cluster objectives and anti-shortcut audit.
options.risks: Unnecessary regeneration, engineered easy positives, origin-specific signatures and misleading prevalence; no support acceptance loop.

options.contract_amendment: Separate modeling approval must resolve Stage18 unused-slot expiration and inherited 36-fit ceiling; no automatic reset or recycling.

options.independent_evaluation: Future assessment must freeze model/threshold before access; no result-informed challenge fitting.
options.justification: HGB rescues 46 A4 and 16 A2 misses, while XGB uniquely detects nine N3 positives; neither dominates.

options.option: Future preregistered model comparison and robustness audit
